text: Lamna Healthcare catch-up with Dr. Amara Nwosu, their CIO. Rule from her: anything we send her is 5 sentences max because she reads email on her phone between ward rounds. And no attachments, she won't open them.
EHR interface go-live is currently 27 Apr. She's nervous because the lab vendor's HL7 test feed keeps slipping.

Wingtip Toys: Chiara Esposito (E-commerce Director) wants a load test of the storefront before their summer sale on 1 Jun. Last year checkout fell over at 3x normal traffic, she wants us to test to 5x.
draft a reply to Chiara proposing a 2-week load test window starting 11 May, results readout by 29 May
Relecloud: Bongani Khumalo (VP Infrastructure) is unhappy about Saturday's cluster upgrade, 25 min of API errors for their customers. Our change was approved but the rollback took way too long.
renewal is 30 Sep, about $310k/yr. he mentioned they're 'looking at options' for the platform team, which I don't love
prep me for a call with Bongani on Thursday, what should I bring?
Vandelay Industries: Rosa Delgado (procurement manager) confirmed they're adding the Hamburg and Gdańsk warehouses to the ERP support contract from 1 Jun. That's 80 more users.
she needs a revised quote with per-user pricing, we're at $22/user/month today
draft the cover note for the revised quote to Rosa: 80 extra users at $22, starting 1 Jun

Munson's Pickles: Hamid Karimi (plant IT manager) wants the factory OT network segmented from the office network after a scare last month with a USB stick on a line PC. Their only downtime window is Sunday 6am to noon.
is that a fixed price job or T&M? we've never seen their OT kit
ok draft a short email to Hamid proposing a paid 2-day site survey first, $4,800 fixed
Southridge Video: Freya Nilsson (head of post-production) needs 200TB more storage before their documentary series lands in June. Quote by next Wednesday.
she prefers the same NAS vendor they have now so the editors don't need retraining
Trey Research: Dr. Kenji Mori (lab systems lead) is upgrading their LIMS in July and needs our validation documentation pack (IQ/OQ) for the infrastructure layer.
he said the auditors come in September so the docs have to be audit-ready, not drafts
draft an email to Kenji listing what's in our validation pack and asking for their target environment details
Margie's Travel: Noor Al-Amin (CX Director) is moving their contact centre to a cloud platform, 140 agents, cutover planned for 7 Sep. She wants us to run the telephony migration.
she's worried about agent training, last migration they lost 2 weeks of productivity
prep me 4 questions for the scoping call with Noor next week
Bongani call went better than expected. He wants a written post-incident review and a commitment that rollback for cluster upgrades stays under 10 minutes.
draft the cover email for the post-incident review, committing to the 10-minute rollback target and a dry run before every upgrade
Wingtip: Chiara accepted the 11 May load test window. She's adding their payments provider to the test plan.
the 5x target works out at roughly 12,000 concurrent sessions
summarise the Wingtip load test plan in 5 bullets for our delivery team
Vandelay: Rosa came back, their finance wants $20/user for the 80 new users. I can go to $21 if they commit to 24 months.
draft the reply to Rosa offering $21/user on a 24-month term
Munson's: Hamid approved the site survey, booked for Tue 28 Apr. He'll walk us through the line PCs himself.
they also have 3 Windows 7 machines driving the labelling printers that can't be upgraded. flag for the survey
PO for the survey comes from their finance team, contact there is Marta Kowalczyk
Southridge storage quote numbers: 200TB usable on their current NAS line, $58k hardware + $9k install, 3-year support at $14k/yr.
draft the quote email to Freya with those numbers, delivery 4 weeks from PO
add that we can stage the install over a weekend so the editors aren't interrupted
Draft a note to Lamna's head of IT: the EHR interface go-live moves from 27 Apr to 11 May because the lab vendor's HL7 test feed still isn't ready, and we need her OK on the new date by Thursday.

expect.should: A note addressed to Dr. Amara Nwosu whose body is at most five sentences (greeting and sign-off not counted), with no attachment, saying the EHR interface go-live moves from 27 Apr to 11 May and asking for her OK by Thursday
expect.should_not: A body longer than five sentences, several paragraphs or headed sections, any attachment or 'see attached', or a note addressed to anyone other than Dr. Amara Nwosu
